steps.title: Shared demo password is rejected on a production database
Registrar admin signs in with the provisioned password
Roster import form starts empty (no prefilled sample person)
Malformed roster row is rejected with the server reason and nothing imported
steps.detail: Nothing was imported. Row 1: Invalid course_code format 'not-a-code' (expected e.g. CS-401).

steps.title: Real roster (3 students, 2 instructors, 2 courses) imports and issues one-time passwords
Admin creates a Dean account by hand; blank password issues a one-time password
Weak initial password chosen by admin is refused
steps.detail: Initial password rejected: Include at least one letter and one number.

steps.title: Student signs in with the one-time password and is forced to /account/password
Server blocks other APIs until the password is changed
Wrong one-time password and a password containing the student number are refused

detail.personal: Do not include your student number, employee ID, or email name.

steps.title: Student sets a valid password and reaches the evaluation queue (2 courses)
Student completes the CS-201 evaluation: 25 varied Likert answers + Taglish comment
Queue shows CS-201 completed and MATH-102 still pending

detail.done: CS-201Data Structures and AlgorithmsProf. Ramon Garcia · ADone Receipt
detail.pending: MATH-102You are hereDiscrete MathematicsProf. Elena Torres · ATo do Start evaluation

steps.title: Receipt verifies publicly at /verify without revealing answers
Faculty (Prof. Ramon Garcia) reaches a locked report before grades are registrar-locked
Registrar marks CS-201 grades submitted and registrar-locked
Faculty now sees the anonymous CS-201 report
Dean signs in with one-time password, sets own password, sees college overview
Mobile 375x812: password screen and queue have no horizontal overflow
Old one-time password no longer signs in after the change
